name: You.com Extract API
desc: Turns any webpage or PDF into clean Markdown or HTML.
desc_zh: 把任意网页或 PDF 转成干净的 Markdown 或 HTML
solves: Scraping a PDF usually destroys its tables. This API keeps rows and columns intact and lets you pick how hard the parser works on charts and images.
solves_zh: 自己抓 PDF 常常把表格结构弄丢。这个 API 保留行和列，还能让你选择对图表和图片下多深的解析功夫。
best_for: Your pipeline already knows the URL and just needs the page as text.
best_for_zh: 你的流程已经知道网址，只差把页面变成文本这一步。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://you.com/docs/changelog (the vendor's own changelog directory)）。 Replaces the Contents API: the changelog says POST /v1/contents still works and existing integrations keep running but will not receive new features. The docs page also carries an announcement banner reading 'NEW Extract API: fetch and parse any URL. 80% higher accuracy on PDFs.' A you-extract MCP tool followed on 2026-11-17 and the Python SDK gained you.extract() the same day. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：官方名字「Extract API」是通用词，带上厂商名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://you.com/docs/changelog/2026/11/16
